weaknesses: The main methodological novelty is limited: the contribution is largely a prompt-engineered multi-stage agent workflow using standard software-planning decomposition, without a strong new algorithmic or learning component.

Reproducibility of the proposed system itself is incomplete: there is no clear released code, generated repositories, benchmark package, cost analysis, or exact sampling/temperature/compute details sufficient for independent replication.
Writing and presentation have many grammatical issues, notation problems, and table inconsistencies, which make the technical claims harder to trust at a top-tier standard.
